precepts.text: No sign shall be given but the sign of Jonas the prophet; as Jonas was a sign to the Ninevites, so shall the son of man be to this generation; men were always the signs, and even Hosea's marriage was his sign, never the woman by herself.
precepts.point: Take counsel together and it shall come to nought, for God is with us, Immanuel: once the child was born, the two kings could not succeed against Judah.

note.label: The Nativity: the Bloodline, Birthright, & the Messiah

precepts.why:
When the people were gathered thick together, Christ said, “This is an evil generation: they seek a sign; and there shall no sign be given it, but the sign of Jonas the prophet.” Then: “For as Jonas was a sign unto the Ninevites, so shall also the Son of man be to this generation.”

Jonas was a sign. The Son of man was a sign. Men were always the signs. There is no scripture where the women were signs. Hosea was also a sign, and his marriage was a sign, but the woman by herself was never a sign.

That settles Isaiah 7 and 8. The Lord said he would give Ahaz a sign, and Isaiah tells us who it was: himself and the children the Lord gave him. The son born to Isaiah and the prophetess was the sign that God was with Judah, Immanuel, and that the two kings coming against Judah would come to nought.

precepts.text: They were trying to get him to come out of the spirit. They were trying to get Christ to speak vehemently and say things that he should not say. But no, Christ kept it spiritual, according to the Bible, the way we should. Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth: trying to catch him, have him slip up in his speech. The same Pharisees back then are here today in 2026.
precepts.point: And they watched him. Who is the they that watched him? The Pharisees. So they was always looking for accusations against Christ. Following him, following him, seeing is he going to slip up that we might accuse him. Remember what Christ said: if they do it unto you, surely they have done it unto me. They follow you block to block, state to state, camp corner to camp corner; surely they have done it unto Christ.

note.label: The Inevitability of Obsolescence & Agony of Defeat

precepts.why:
The Pharisees watched Christ in the synagogue so they might accuse him, and Luke shows how far they went: “the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things.” They were trying to get him to come out of the spirit, to speak vehemently and say things he should not say.

But no, Christ kept it spiritual, according to the Bible, the way we should.

“Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.” Trying to catch him and have him slip up in his speech. The same Pharisees back then are here today in 2026, provoking and laying wait for something to catch out of our mouths, and the answer is the same: stay in the spirit.

precepts.text: Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; if Satan be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand?
precepts.point: The fourth kingdom, Rome extended in Europe and America, is strong as iron but mixed with miry clay. The kingdom shall be divided, partly strong and partly broken.

note.label: Civil War & the Son of Perdition

precepts.why:
The fourth kingdom “shall be strong as iron” is Rome, and Europe and America are the extension of Rome. Strong as iron means strong militarily. But Daniel goes on: in the feet and toes, “part of potters’ clay, and part of iron, the kingdom shall be divided; but there shall be in it of the strength of the iron”. They have that same military strength Rome had, yet “the kingdom shall be partly strong, and partly broken.” Why broken? Because they are divided. That is what you see taking place right now: America is divided.

Christ said it: “Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation; and a house divided against a house falleth.” A lot of times we use this for when we were divided in Jerusalem, and it is. But it is also speaking of the last days, of the kingdom that is set up in the last days, and it tells us what happens before its destruction.

Read on: “If Satan also be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand?” Which kingdom is Satan's kingdom? Europe and America. America and Europe are divided; that alliance is falling apart. Here in America the citizens are divided. Satan is divided against himself, and that is a sign that they are about to fall. How can his kingdom stand? It can't.

The same division is prophesied of Egypt, and America is spiritually called Egypt: “I will set the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbour; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.” White people will be fighting white people, city against city, the same way the South fought against the North in the Civil War. The Lord is behind all of it.

So the iron kingdom of Daniel 2:40 is strong, but its own division is what brings it to desolation. The civil war things are already going on, even in the drawing of new districts between Texas and California to hold the House and the Senate. Pay attention: a house divided against a house falls.

precepts.text: I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute.
precepts.point: The merchants weep for the gold, spices, oil and slaves that came from the dark nations. In her was found the blood of prophets.

note.label: Donald Trump: the Sword of God

precepts.why:
“Come out of her, my people.” Come out of America’s ways, come out of their filth, and do not partake in the sins of Babylon, “that ye receive not of her plagues.” Babylon is America, and “God hath remembered her iniquities.” For all the bombs she dropped on the nations of the earth, the Lord says “double unto her double according to her works.” She “lived deliciously” on the resources, the minerals and the strength of the dark nations, particularly Africa; and among her merchandise are “slaves, and souls of men”, the Israelites. Our people’s soul is knit to America; they want her to last forever.

Then: “in her was found the blood of prophets, and of saints, and of all that were slain upon the earth.” Where are the prophets? Right here. You are the prophets, you are the saints, in Babylon which is America.

Luke 11:49 proves it: “Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles, and some of them they shall slay and persecute.” God sends his prophets and apostles, and some of them are slain and persecuted. That is the blood found in Babylon.

So come out of her, because her judgment is coming: “in one hour is thy judgment come.” And when Babylon is destroyed, what do you do? “Rejoice over her, thou heaven, and ye holy apostles and prophets; for God hath avenged you on her.”

precepts.text: Therefore also said the wisdom of God, I will send them prophets and apostles: Christ called himself the wisdom of God.
precepts.point: Christ is the power of God and the wisdom of God, so the wisdom created in Proverbs 8 and in Sirach 24 is Christ.

precepts.text: The scribes and Pharisees provoked Christ, laying wait to catch something out of His mouth to accuse Him, wicked enough to provoke the Son of the living God.
precepts.point: He asks whether they shall escape by iniquity, and trusts that the Most High tells his wanderings and keeps his tears in a bottle, and that his enemies shall turn back because God is for him.

note.label: Psalm 56: I Will Not Fear What Flesh Can Do Unto Me

precepts.why:
“Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil. They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.” This is David in the spirit foreseeing what would happen to Christ. “the scribes and the Pharisees began to urge him vehemently, and to provoke him to speak of many things: Laying wait for him, and seeking to catch something out of his mouth, that they might accuse him.”

They provoked Christ and lay in wait to catch something out of his mouth to accuse him; they wrested his words every day and marked his steps. They were wicked enough to provoke the Son of the living God. And as David said, shall they escape by iniquity? God is for him, and his enemies turn back.

moments.label: Integrated but Divided: What Did We Lose?

points: But he, knowing their thoughts, said unto them, Every kingdom divided against itself is brought to desolation. Every kingdom that is divided against itself is brought to desolation. That kingdom is brought to desolation. In other words, any kingdom where they have no unity is brought to destruction.

And a house divided against a house falleth. If your house, inside your house, if it is divided — in other words, you against your wife, your wife is against you, your children against you, you against your children — falleth. He is going to fall. He is going to be destroyed. He is not going to stand. That is what he is saying.

Ooh, that is some powerful stuff right there. I want you to meditate on what he is saying. So Satan got a kingdom. He said, if Satan divide against itself, Satan's kingdom cannot stand. Where is he going? What is he saying?

note.label: Integrated but Divided: What Did We Lose?

points: If Satan also be divided against himself. Now he said, if Satan, if the devil also be divided — so if Satan is divided, can Satan be divided? No. In other words, you cannot divide against yourself. If Satan be divided against himself, how shall his kingdom stand?

Because ye say that I cast out devils through Beelzebub. So remember, the Pharisees come against Christ. They told Christ, you cast out devils by the devil. That makes no sense. In other words, you are saying that this certain kingdom is divided. That makes no sense.
